wave.summary: All four reproduced findings fixed in server/index.js, committed as 0b5d238 on wave-670349-R-015. (1) /api/scan-events is now a persistent SSE stream: the server never ends a live stream (that close was what drove EventSource's ~3s auto-reconnect replay loop); streams end only on client disconnect (req 'close') or server shutdown. (2) Retained scan events are cleared in the scan's finally, after snapshot swap + saveCache and after the deferred terminal 'done' broadcast — replay exists only during a live scan, so an idle-period subscriber gets nothing, never a stale 'done'. (3) DECISION STATED EXPLICITLY per conductor instructions: emptySnapshot() KEEPS generatedAt: null as the deliberate pre-first-scan sentinel, now documented with a comment cross-referencing the UI's explicit null handling (src/App.tsx / useAtlas); no UI files were touched. (4) state.latest writers are sequenced via a new state.scanLanded flag — the async cache seed applies only if no scan result has landed. Tests: 3 new tests added (persistent subscriber held over a raw http connection across a scan receives exactly one terminal done and the stream stays open; a subscriber joining after completion receives zero events with the stream open; a slow cache seed — stale bytes read at boot but resolving after a fast scan lands — cannot overwrite the fresher snapshot; the mock deliberately reads-early/resolves-late because delaying the read itself would just re-read the freshly saved cache and miss the race, which I caught when the first version of the test wrongly passed against the pre-fix server). All 4 new/changed behaviors were verified to FAIL against the pre-fix server/index.js and pass with the fix. The 13 pre-existing server tests are preserved with their assertions intact except mechanically adapting the SSE drain helper (streams no longer server-close, so tests read until 'done' then disconnect client-side) and the 'no scan has ever run' test, whose 'closes cleanly' assertion enshrined the reproduced bug — it now asserts emits-nothing-and-stays-open, which is strictly the mandated new contract, not a weakening. Full suite: 208 tests green (server suite 16/16, run twice for stability). Preserved contracts re-verified by the suite: cache-first /api/atlas never-500, single-flight rescan, 404 unknown repo, traversal safety, mime types, SPA fallback.
